181.news_title: New Arcade Monitor Mounting Bracket Range
181.long_description: We know that every arcade cabinet and display project is different. That's why we've expanded our range of new arcade monitor mounting brackets, giving builders, repairers, operators, and hobbyists more installation options than ever before. Our new bracket range is designed to simplify monitor installation across a wide variety of arcade cabinets, custom builds, kiosks, and industrial display applications. Whether you're mounting into an existing arcade machine or arcade cabinet, a custom build, or commercial display, you will find the correct monitor mounting brackets. As with our monitors, we have been testing the mounting brackets internally with many types of arcade machines. These have included Sega, Namco, Taito, Gaelco, Atari, Midway and Konami arcade machines. Arcade cabinets handled have included Dance Dance Revolution, Cruisn World, Crazy Taxi, Tokyo Cop, Speed Up NBA Jam and Mortal Kombat. Our customers have also been sharing data on Windy Candy cabinets, Sega Naomi cabinets and others. We are constantly upgrading our mounting brackets with the kind support of our customers. If there are mismatches, or new updates to be made, we will revise or add new mounting brackets to suit the community. Our goal is to offer a professional plug and play solution, saving time and money when handling CRT monitor replacements and new installations. Carefully review your arcade machine or application, and review against the various monitor mounting brackets as some models will have adjustable positioning. The monitor mounting brackets are designed to work with the Arcooda range of LCD monitors, and will offer a flat and perfect installation solution. Browse the new Monitor Mounting Bracket range today and find the right solution for your next arcade build or monitor upgrade.
